title: The Hustler's Guide to Elder Care

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: This is the next cycle (Q1 2020) of Hustlin' Tech .
reader_summary.overview: This is the next cycle (Q1 2020) of Hustlin' Tech , a podcast series (from the a16z Podcast) about technology platforms that create opportunities for people. Recorded right before the coronavirus pandemic, these next 3 episodes touch on many things that are top of mind right now: from the profession of nursing . Episode #5, “The Hustler’s Guide to Taking Care of Old Folks” features: Seth Sternberg, CEO and co-founder of Honor .
